title: Finite geometric cohomology model and normalized scalar comparison
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, a separable closure $k^s$, and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$. Let $X/k$ be separated of finite type. Let $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be an algebraic closure with its norm topology and $E\subset\Omega$ finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Put $C(P)=\{f\in C(P,\Omega):f(P)\text{ lies in one finite subextension}\}$ and $B(P)=C(P,\Omega)$, and let $c:C\to B$ be inclusion [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Put $A=\underline E$ and, for a condensed ring $R$, $R_X=p_X^*R$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use internal ordinary derived relative tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For a bounded constructible $V\in D(A_X)$ in the finite constant local model convention [sk-def-sfb-constructible], put $K_A=\mathcal K_A(V)$ and $K_R=\mathcal K_R(R_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V)$ for $R=C,B$, with the equivariant geometric derived section functors of [lem-sfb-condensed-galois-global-descent].

The object $K_A$ is bounded in $D(\mathcal A_G(A))$. For every integer $q$ there is a finite-dimensional norm-topological $E$-vector space $W_q$ with continuous $E$-linear $G$-action such that $H^q(K_A)$ is its condensed module $P\mapsto C(P,W_q)$, equivariantly; $W_q=0$ outside a finite interval.

For $R=C,B$, the actual derived coefficient projection morphism
$$\beta_R:R\otimes_A^L K_A\longrightarrow K_R$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal A_G(R))$. This morphism is specified, not an unspecified isomorphism: it is the transpose, under the derived adjunction $R\otimes_A^L-\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{A\to R}$ on equivariant derived categories, of the composite $K_A=\mathcal K_A(V)\xrightarrow{\mathcal K_A(\eta_V)}\mathcal K_A(\operatorname{Res}(R_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V))\to\operatorname{Res}\mathcal K_R(R_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V)$, where $\eta_V$ is the derived scalar-extension unit, represented on a K-flat resolution by $v\mapsto1\otimes v$, and the second arrow is the canonical comparison of the derived geometric section functors with the exact scalar restriction. Let $\kappa:\mathcal K_C(C_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V)\to\operatorname{Res}_c\mathcal K_B(B_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V)$ be $\mathcal K_C$ of the morphism $C_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V\to\operatorname{Res}_{c_X}(B_X\otimes^L_{A_X}V)$ induced by $z\otimes v\mapsto c_X(z)\otimes v$, followed by the same canonical comparison with scalar restriction. Then the square $\operatorname{Res}_c(\beta_B)\circ\gamma=\kappa\circ\beta_C$ commutes in $D(\mathcal A_G(C))$, where $\gamma:C\otimes_A^LK_A\to\operatorname{Res}_c(B\otimes_A^LK_A)$ is induced by $z\otimes v\mapsto c(z)\otimes v$; in particular it commutes after further restriction to $A$. The assertions are natural in $V$ and compatible with shifts. They do not assert that $C_X\to B_X$ is an isomorphism or flat, or that $\Omega$ is complete.

proof.text: Write $a:X\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Since $a$ is separated of finite type with affine target, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine] makes $X$ qcqs. Apply [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport]: $K_R=D(E_R)Ra_{*,R}$ with t-exact transport preserving scalar units, counits and the specified projections. Forgetting $G$ is exact conservative and gives geometric derived sections over $X^s$, so detects invertibility of the actual $\beta_R$.

proof.text: On each stratum, finite constant local models are locally finitely presented by [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Apply [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves] to $a$ with $A=\underline E$: both schemes are separated finite type over $k$, and $p\ne\ell$. Thus $M=Ra_{*,A}V$ is bounded constructible in the stratified local-finite-presentation sense. Apply [lem-sfb-geometric-finite-cohomology-model] to $M$ with the transport of step 1 to obtain the equivariant $W_q$ and their finite vanishing interval.

proof.text: For $C$, $a$ is qcqs and $V$ bounded below. The canonical projection is invertible by [lem-sfb-qlbar-direct-image-comparison], using finite-subextension-valued $C$. Its normalized transport by [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport], applicable by step 1, proves invertibility of the specified $\beta_C$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-geometric-generator-projection-devissage] with this $k,k^s,X,E,\Omega,V$. It gives the geometric pullback, its finite lattice-generator construction, and invertibility of the unit-normalized norm projection. By [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport] this is exactly the forgotten $\beta_B$; exact conservativity gives its invertibility in $D(\mathcal A_G(B))$. No infinite totalization is involved.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-geometric-coefficient-square-transport] on $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to $A_s\to C_s\to B_s$ and $a$. Transport its equality by [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport]. Because both inputs preserve scalar units and restriction comparisons, its $\gamma,\kappa,\beta$ are the maps specified here, giving $\operatorname{Res}_c(\beta_B)\circ\gamma=\kappa\circ\beta_C$ in the $C$-equivariant category and then over $A$. The same inputs give naturality and shift compatibility. For $V=0$ or $X=\varnothing$ the objects vanish; $G=1$ removes no additional information.

The item changes only in two places: step 1 now proves X is qcqs via lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine (the citation moved from step 3), and step 2 now says the constant models are lfp stratum by stratum and that the dc-lower-star output is lfp-constructible. The statement and stmt_deps are unchanged, every cited statement equals live, there is no SGA citation and no cycle. Allocation: old steps 1 and 3 are kept as parent steps; old step 2 becomes the finite-cohomology node plus the dc-lower-star step; old steps 4-5 become the generator node plus the conservative lift; old steps 6-7 become the square node plus transport. Nothing was dropped, and no child restates the equivariant item. Step checks: (1) field-action transport gives D(E_R)Ra_* ≅ K_R for qcqs X, identifies β, and makes forgetting G exact and conservative. (2) dc-lower-star applies with Λ=E̲ (dc-setting needs only char p≠ℓ and a separated finite-type morphism), and its lfp output is the hypothesis of the finite-cohomology node. (3) qlbar-direct-image-comparison uses the filtered-union C and needs a qcqs map and bounded-below V, both of which hold. (4) The generator node's π_{V^s} with T=X^s is exactly the forgotten β_B. (5) The square node on s_proet with A→C→B is transported by E_C. New nodes: the finite-cohomology node is true for any k (Spec k is Noetherian, certificate family E, one stratum, finitely presented E-modules are free, t-exactness). The generator node follows from u^*, integral-models-generators(1), the supported-lattice node with K=k^s, and two-out-of-three. I checked the square node by transposes: Res_a(m)η^a=η^{ca} because c(1)=1, and the restriction comparisons compose, so both sides equal d^{ca}G_A(η^{ca}). Overlap with topos-scalar-mate-transitivity (Q154) and scalar-direct-image-mate-coherence (NM): those are counit-form composition laws, so this is not a duplicate (advisory). Accepted tool uses: dc-lower-star, qlbar-direct-image-comparison, qcqs-over-affine. No fixes. Maintainer note: this is a landing-return re-delivery of a PASSed split, and L should promote it.
